description: Implementation of MojoDemuxerStreamImpl class handling media stream demuxing, configuration, and buffer processing in Chromium media component.

classes.name: MojoDemuxerStreamImpl
classes.description: Implements a media demuxer stream interface using Mojo IPC, managing stream initialization, reading buffers, and handling config changes.

methods.name: MojoDemuxerStreamImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the demuxer stream with a media stream and Mojo receiver.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Prepares initial stream configuration and notifies the client.

methods.name: EnableBitstreamConverter
methods.description: Enables bitstream conversion on the stream.

methods.name: OnBufferReady
methods.description: Handles buffers received from the stream, manages config changes, and passes data to the callback.
